ambiguities.text: User interaction delay before resolution/rejection is permitted - no maximum timeout specified
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume implementations should allow indefinite delay while user considers the request. Applications should handle this gracefully with loading states.

ambiguities.text: The specification does not define behavior for repeated requests after user rejection
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume providers may either show the dialog again or immediately reject. Implementations should respect user fatigue and avoid spam.

ambiguities.text: 'Informative Error object' - the structure and required properties of the error are not defined
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume Error object must have at minimum a message property. Consider using standardized error codes from EIP-1193.

implicit_assumptions.description: The browser environment correctly isolates the approval dialog from DApp manipulation
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: DApps could forge or dismiss consent dialogs, gaining unauthorized account access

implicit_assumptions.description: Users understand the security implications of granting account access
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Users may grant access to malicious sites without understanding the privacy exposure

implicit_assumptions.description: The provider implementation faithfully displays the requesting origin to the user
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Origin spoofing could lead users to grant access believing they are on a trusted site
